KiddieLearn-Privacy-Notice-v2.docx.text:
KiddieLearn Privacy Notice v2
Issued for October 2026 desk review
Collection and purpose
Effective 18 August 2026. We collect a learner alias, school year and parent email to deliver lessons and progress reports. The signup page presents separate lesson and optional research choices.
For optional recommendation profiling we rely on GDPR legitimate interest under Article 6(1)(f). The same basis is printed in the parent-facing notice.
We retain lesson accounts for 90 days after closure. Parent emails remain for service messages until closure. Please see the deletion register for completed purges.
Rights and contacts
Parents may request correction or erasure using privacy@kiddielearn.example; the support queue records the ticket and completion date. A grievance may be sent to the same address and is acknowledged within two working days.
The access-request page says a summary of data held is returned through the parent dashboard. The dashboard export currently lists account profile fields only.
Governance
A parent may request that another adult manage the account after incapacity. The release is scheduled for 15 November 2026; the current account page has no nomination field.

KiddieLearn-Security-Standard-2026.pdf.text:
Engineering security and retention standard
Issued for October 2026 desk review
Access and storage
The production database uses service-managed encryption at rest. Production exports must use encrypted private buckets and be deleted within 24 hours. The CTO approves engineer access monthly.
The lesson feature collects learner alias, school year and parent email. The support form also stores free-text teacher notes and birth month, which are not needed for lesson delivery.
Retention
Inactive accounts are reviewed weekly; 30 September 2026 cohort: 126 closures requested, 91 purges completed, 35 remain in the retry queue. The dashboard reports the 91 completions only.
The processor copy held by MetricTree has no deletion job yet. The next integration sprint is scheduled for November 2026.
Incident handling
The CTO triages security events, keeps an incident log and calls the parent-contact owner for affected accounts. A response checklist and escalation rota were approved on 2026-07-08.

KiddieLearn signup and parent verification capture
Capture 2026-09-22 build 4.8.1; learner age entry: 9; parent email: parent@example.test
Learner step: enter birth year; no independent age check is performed.
Parent step: one-time link to parent mailbox; link challenge 6 digits, expires after 10 minutes.
Lesson delivery [selected by parent]  Optional research [separate unchecked box]
Session token for parent approval stored with version 4.8.1 and UTC timestamp; parent billing token is matched to the account holder.
Optional research can be switched off in parent settings; the research SDK stops receiving new events immediately.
Analytics SDK: KidsAdNet child-device event stream enabled on the learner home screen.
Request correction and close account buttons are visible in parent settings.
Nominate another adult: planned for November release.
